_doc: Example run config in dceprep form: file lists are globs relative to the session's
derivatives folder rather than literal paths, which is what run_dce_bids_batch.py's
--config-template expects when you want to override its auto-discovery.
Every knob not listed under stage_overrides resolves from python/dce_defaults.json,
the single source for defaults, limits and preferences. See dce_run_example_bids.json for
the literal-path form the CLI and GUI use.
This is the one example that sets 'relaxivity' in stage_overrides, as a study-wide
fallback: a batch sweeps many sessions, and any whose sidecar omits it would otherwise
stop the run. Sessions that do carry it in their sidecar use that instead -- the sidecar
outranks this file for per-scan values.
